4columns x2rows,384x512cells, FULL bodies approximately412px hair-to-sole, hair top35 sole447. TOP ROW four NORTHEAST views: three-quarter BACK walking toward IMAGE UPPER-RIGHT. BOTTOM ROW four NORTH views: directly BACK, walking straight away, no face visible.

ONE large broad sheathed back sword matching image2, hilt anatomical RIGHT shoulder, angular scabbard to opposite hip, consistent asymmetry in both actual views. No duplicate sword.
